newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says Axa, UAP merger plan good.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says Axa, UAP merger plan good.

text.p: PARIS, Nov 12 (Reuter) French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday that a merger plan between Axa and UAP appeared to be a good plan but it was up to shareholders to comment.
"There is potential for strong synergies. It is a good project," he told reporters after addressing the economic and social council.
He noted that Europe was moving forward in its efforts to create a giant single market. "Everyone must prepare to be on a European or indeed worldwide scale," he said.
Earlier on Tuesday, Axa and UAP said they planned to merge, creating the world's second largest insurance company.
